description: Configurable strategy and recommendation weights for AIStackRecommendationEngine.

compositeScore._comment: Default baseline weights if no strategy is specified.

preferenceModifiers._comment: Maximum score adjustment per user preference toggle. Each is applied GRADED against provider-specific measured data (see getPreferenceModifiersNet), not fired by a threshold: the value below is the adjustment at full effect. The previous `applyWhen` thresholds were inert — vendorLockInRisk is "Low" in all 13 provider files, vendorStabilityScore < 50 matches one provider, and zeroDataRetention is unverified catalogue-wide so it subtracted the same constant from every candidate.

avoidLockIn.gradedBy: exitFriction = 0.7 x (100 - portability) + 0.3 x vendorConcentration; portability = model breadth + researched api capability

preferOpenSource.gradedBy: portability (model breadth + researched api capability). No openWeights field exists in the knowledge base; portability is the honest proxy.

requireZeroRetention.gradedBy: verified + flag true -> 0; verified + flag false -> full penalty; unverified -> penalty x (1 - researched enterpriseSecurity/10)

confidenceWeights._comment: Weights for 7-factor confidence score per recommendation. Must sum to 1.0.
